examples.en: The man is drinking a coffee.
The woman is eating an apple.

examples.fr: Je mange du pain le matin.
examples.en: I eat bread in the morning.
The fish is in the water.
The taxi is going to the airport.
I am going to the hotel.
I am looking at the map.
The train station is on the left.
The hotel is on the right.

examples.fr: Je donne un cadeau à ma mère.
examples.en: I am giving a gift to my mother.

examples.fr: Le patron arrive à huit heures.
examples.en: The boss arrives at eight o'clock.

examples.fr: Le papier est sur la table.
examples.en: The paper is on the table.
